notes.title: Small Update where we fixed the wrong button assignments
notes.content:
Hey!

The wrong button assignment that went through with the last update has been fixed!

Sorry that this one took us so long. If I am being upfront it's because no one of us was really aware of the Steam Community discussions going on. Between handling all our social media pages we didn't expect that we won't get any notifications if anyone starts a new discussion about Chapeau on Steam. ːsteamsadː

Please excuse us, as we are learning all the things on the get go to make not only Chapeau, but also future releases run more smoothly in the future!

- Mat

tags.bug: The wrong button assignment that went through with the last update has been fixed!

notes.title: First Update to Chapeau - The Party Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, the first update to Chapeau has just been released, here are the quick[b] patch notes[/b]:

[list]
[*] 1 New fantastic hat is available to play
[*] All maps are unlocked from the start, instead of being locked behind the challenge mode
[*] A visual bug in the tutorial parkour has been fixed
[*] The birdies should now correctly return to their position, making it easier to get the birdie achievement
[/list]

We want everyone who just wants to play the game in the multiplayer mode to experience all maps regardless of Challenge mode progress, hats and skins are still unlock able.

Cheers, I hope you have fun with the update!
Mat

notes.title: Alpha Content Update: New Mode "The Floor is Lava"!
notes.content:
The second content update to the alpha has been released containing some new features and fixes:

New Features:
+ Another new mode! Dash your enemies into the lava in "The Floor Is Lava"!

Fixes:
+ Fixed Hat names not showing correctly.
+ Worked on some backbone stuff to improve the collisions.
+ Fixed controller identification bugs, when connecting and disconnecting several controllers.

The glitches in the pre-warm box are not fixed yet, because of a few complications that we didn't foresee, but they are getting fixed soon.

Have fun with new content and tell us how you like the lava mode!

tags.bug: + Fixed Hat names not showing correctly.
+ Fixed controller identification bugs, when connecting and disconnecting several controllers.

notes.title: Alpha Content Update: New Mode "Where Is Wilhelm"!
notes.content:
[b]The first content update to the alpha has been released containing some new features and fixes:[/b]

[u]New Features:[/u]
+ A new mode! Find the right person and collect coins in "Where is Willhelm"!
+ A new map! Jump around between old buildings close to the water on "Bregenz Piers"
+ A new hat! Play the Bowler Hat "Mr. Hattleberry"
+ A new trail! Use the Donut Trail to feed your hunger for trails

[u]Fixes:[/u]
+ Fixed Wallslides in the tutorial at ground level
+ Fixed most cases of getting stuck between collisions
+ Fixed Stomp effect not properly stopping
+ Fixed Stomp into Wallslide resulting in "Stomp Storage" (Thanks @Popa21#2085 )
+ Fixed visual bugs with the trails in the Character Selection
+ Fixed some walls not behaving correctly in the tutorial with Wallslides
+ Adjusted some light settings on Prater, this is for further optimizing in the future on other maps
+ Fixed flickering shadows in prewarm boxes
+ Optimization changes on Prater

 Have fun with new content and tell us how you like the new mode!

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
We have just pushed an update to Steam with a few changes and fixes:
+ Completely reworked Mouse Input (No in-game sensitivity yet for the mouse, as it's direct input!)
+ Basic Quality Settings (Default is on low: change it in the options menu!)
+ Fixed getting stuck against a wall while dashing
+ Fixed respawn in tutorial getting stuck
+ Fixed minor UI issues
+ Reworked human rig for better performance
+ Fixed UI clipping into objects
+ Fixed Confetti FX in win screen

We're also introducing the Duke's Discord Challenge!
With every content release of the alpha, there will be a challenge. Whoever posts a screenshot of them completing the challenge first on our Discord, get's the role "The Duke", until the next challenge comes.

The first challenge will be...
Find the hidden Alpaca in the game! The first one who posts a screenshot of it, get's the role.

Have fun with the small update and tell us if you like or dislike the new mouse controls!

notes.title: The Alpha is now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Alpha is out now!

Get a key on Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/KUaZkte]Discord[/url]

[previewyoutube=wemDNU3Nok0;full][/previewyoutube]

Engage in some frantic HAT action! Play alone or gather your friends around and enjoy a few rounds of Chapeau.

Everyone here is excited about this, as it is our FIRST time releasing something as a studio, working together. After graduating we came together to found SaltCastleStudio and with a lot of help from friends and family we got to where we are etching closer and closer to an official release.

What's in it?

- 1 Mode to beat your friends, or the AI in

- 2 Maps for you to play

- 3 different Hats to choose from

- 4 Trails to follow you wherever you go

- 1 Tutorial Speeeeeeeed Course that let's you race against the time

We would recommend playing with a controller, but you can also enjoy Chapeau on a keyboard.
There will be updates happening to the alpha, some may change the mode, the hats or the maps around. It will run for about 6 weeks in total.
